name: mmntjs
description: Drop-in replacement for moment.js — a migration path to Temporal API

scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run build && TZ=UTC bun test ./test/bundle-smoke.test.ts -t 'runtime smoke'
scripts.build: rm -rf dist/entry && mkdir -p packages/timezone/node_modules && ln -sfn ../../.. packages/timezone/node_modules/mmntjs && for dir in test/kibana-compat test/grafana-compat; do mkdir -p "$dir/node_modules" && ln -sfn ../../../dist/index.js "$dir/node_modules/moment" && ln -sfn ../../../dist/index.js "$dir/node_modules/mmntjs" && ln -sfn ../../../packages/timezone/dist/index.js "$dir/node_modules/moment-timezone"; done && bun scripts/generate-timezone-data.ts && tsup && bun scripts/copy-dts.ts && bun scripts/generate-locale-auto.ts && rm -rf dist/locale/test-locales* && rm -f dist/locale/*.map && rm -rf dist/entry && bun -e "require('fs').readdirSync('dist',{recursive:true}).filter(f=>f.endsWith('.map')).forEach(f=>{const p='dist/'+f;const m=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(p,'utf8'));delete m.sourcesContent;require('fs').writeFileSync(p,JSON.stringify(m))})" && (cd packages/timezone && bun run build || true)
scripts.test: bun run test:quick && bun run test:mutation && bun run fuzz:quick
scripts.test:quick: bun run test:core && bun run test:tz:quick && bun run test:locale:quick && bun run test:extra && bun run test:bin
scripts.test:kibana: TZ=UTC bun test --preload ./test/kibana-compat/approaches/approach-c-preload.ts ./test/kibana-compat/kibana-compat.test.ts && TZ=UTC bun test --preload ./test/kibana-compat/approaches/approach-c-preload.ts ./test/kibana-compat/approaches/approach-a-npm-alias.test.ts && TZ=UTC bun test ./test/kibana-compat/approaches/approach-b-direct-import.test.ts && TZ=UTC bun test --preload ./test/kibana-compat/approaches/approach-c-preload.ts ./test/kibana-compat/approaches/approach-c-preload.test.ts && TZ=UTC bun test ./test/kibana-compat/kbn-datemath-runner.test.ts
scripts.bench:guard: bun bench/bench-regression.ts && bun bench/bench-parse-eval.ts && bun bench/bench-lookup.ts
scripts.lint: oxfmt src test packages/timezone/src packages/timezone/test && oxlint --type-aware --type-check src packages/timezone/src && oxlint src test packages/timezone/test
scripts.fuzz:quick: bun run build > /dev/null && echo 'build OK' && bash scripts/run-quiet.sh jazzer test/fuzz/parse.fuzz.js --sync -i dist/ -- -runs=500 -max_len=64 && bash scripts/run-quiet.sh jazzer test/fuzz/format.fuzz.js --sync -i dist/ -- -runs=500 -max_len=64 && bash scripts/run-quiet.sh jazzer test/fuzz/duration.fuzz.js --sync -i dist/ -- -runs=500 -max_len=32 && bash scripts/run-quiet.sh jazzer test/fuzz/operations.fuzz.js --sync -i dist/ -- -runs=500 -max_len=32 && bash scripts/run-quiet.sh jazzer test/fuzz/array-input.fuzz.js --sync -i dist/ -- -runs=500 -max_len=32 && bash scripts/run-quiet.sh jazzer test/fuzz/utc.fuzz.js --sync -i dist/ -- -runs=500 -max_len=64 && bash scripts/run-quiet.sh jazzer test/fuzz/object-input.fuzz.js --sync -i dist/ -- -runs=500 -max_len=32 && bash scripts/run-quiet.sh jazzer test/fuzz/reltime.fuzz.js --sync -i dist/ -- -runs=500 && bash scripts/run-quiet.sh jazzer test/fuzz/diff-datefns.fuzz.js --sync -i dist/ -- -runs=500 -max_len=16 && bash scripts/run-quiet.sh jazzer test/fuzz/diff-luxon.fuzz.js --sync -i dist/ -- -runs=500 -max_len=16 && bash scripts/run-quiet.sh jazzer test/fuzz/diff-dayjs.fuzz.js --sync -i dist/ -- -runs=500 -max_len=16 && echo 'fuzz OK'
scripts.fuzz: bun run build && jazzer test/fuzz/parse.fuzz.js --sync -i dist/ -- -max_total_time=60 -minimize_crash=1
scripts.fuzz:grammar: bun run build && jazzer test/fuzz/grammar.fuzz.js --sync -i dist/ -- -runs=10000 -max_len=48
scripts.fuzz:grammar:quick: bun run build && jazzer test/fuzz/grammar.fuzz.js --sync -i dist/ -- -runs=500 -max_len=48
scripts.fuzz:diff: jazzer test/fuzz/diff-datefns.fuzz.js --sync -i dist/ -- -runs=500 -max_len=16 && jazzer test/fuzz/diff-luxon.fuzz.js --sync -i dist/ -- -runs=500 -max_len=16 && jazzer test/fuzz/diff-dayjs.fuzz.js --sync -i dist/ -- -runs=500 -max_len=16
scripts.audit:static: bun run knip && bun run fallow
scripts.ci: bun run lint && TZ=UTC bun run test:hard && bun run test:tz && bun run build && bun run knip && bun run fallow
scripts.coverage:heatmap: bun run test:coverage && bun run fuzz:heatmap
